part: Part IV: How the Argonauts Sailed to Colchis
raw: And the heroes sat silent awhile before the face of that ancient king. But Hera the awful goddess put courage into Jason’s heart, and he rose and shouted loudly in answer, ‘We are no pirates nor lawless men.  We come not to plunder and to ravage, or carry away slaves from your land; but my uncle, the son of Poseidon, Pelias the Minuan king, he it is who has set me on a quest to bring home the golden fleece.  And these too, my bold comrades, they are no nameless men; for some are the sons of Immortals, and some of heroes far renowned.  And we too never tire in battle, and know well how to give blows and to take: yet we wish to be guests at your table: it will be better so for both.’

translation.en: The heroes sat silently for a moment before the ancient king.
translation.kr: 영웅들은 그 늙은 왕 앞에서 잠시 말없이 앉아 있었습니다.

translation.en: But the awe-inspiring goddess Hera put courage into Jason's heart.
translation.kr: 하지만 경외감을 자아내는 여신 헤라가 이아손의 마음에 용기를 불어넣었습니다.

translation.en: He stood up and shouted his answer boldly.
translation.kr: 그는 자리에서 일어나 담대하게 소리쳐 대답했습니다.

translation.en: We are neither pirates nor lawless men.
translation.kr: 우리는 해적도 무법자도 아닙니다.

translation.en: We have not come to plunder, destroy, or take slaves from your land.
translation.kr: 우리는 당신의 땅을 약탈하거나 파괴하거나 노예를 잡아가려고 온 것이 아닙니다.

translation.en: My uncle Pelias, the Minyan king and son of Poseidon, sent me on a quest.
translation.kr: 포세이돈의 아들이자 미니아스의 왕인 제 삼촌 펠리아스가 저에게 임무를 맡겼습니다.

translation.en: He commanded me to bring the golden fleece back home.
translation.kr: 그는 제게 황금 양모를 고향으로 가져오라고 명령했습니다.

translation.en: My brave comrades here are not nameless men, either.
translation.kr: 여기 있는 제 용감한 동료들도 이름 없는 자들이 아닙니다.

translation.en: Some are sons of immortals, and others are famous heroes.
translation.kr: 어떤 이들은 불멸의 신들의 아들이고, 또 어떤 이들은 널리 알려진 영웅들입니다.

translation.en: We never tire in battle and know exactly how to fight.
translation.kr: 우리는 전투에서 결코 지치지 않으며 싸우는 법을 아주 잘 알고 있습니다.

translation.en: Yet we wish to be peaceful guests at your table.
translation.kr: 하지만 우리는 당신의 식탁에서 평화로운 손님이 되고 싶습니다.

translation.en: This will be much better for both of us.
translation.kr: 그것이 우리 양측 모두에게 훨씬 나을 것입니다.

part: Part IV: How the Argonauts Sailed to Colchis
raw: Then Aietes’ race rushed up like a whirlwind, and his eyes flashed fire as he heard; but he crushed his anger down in his breast, and spoke mildly a cunning speech—

translation.en: King Aeetes's anger flared like a whirlwind.
translation.kr: 아이에테스 왕의 분노가 회오리바람처럼 치솟았습니다.

translation.en: His eyes flashed with fire as he listened.
translation.kr: 그의 눈은 이야기를 듣는 내내 불꽃처럼 번쩍였습니다.

translation.en: But he forced his rage down and spoke a cunning response mildly.
translation.kr: 하지만 그는 분노를 억누르고 온화한 태도로 교활한 대답을 꺼냈습니다.

part: Part IV: How the Argonauts Sailed to Colchis
raw: ‘If you will fight for the fleece with my Colchians, then many a man must die.  But do you indeed expect to win from me the fleece in fight?  So few you are that if you be worsted I can load your ship with your corpses.  But if you will be ruled by me, you will find it better far to choose the best man among you, and let him fulfil the labours which I demand.  Then I will give him the golden fleece for a prize and a glory to you all.’

translation.en: If you fight my Colchian warriors for the fleece, many men will die.
translation.kr: 당신들이 황금 양모를 두고 콜키스 전사들과 싸운다면 많은 사람이 죽을 것이오.

translation.en: Do you truly expect to win the fleece from me in battle?
translation.kr: 당신들은 정말 전투를 통해 내게서 양모를 얻을 수 있다고 생각하시오?

translation.en: You have so few men that I could fill your ship with your corpses.
translation.kr: 당신들은 수가 너무 적어서 패배하면 당신들의 시체로 배를 채울 수도 있소.

translation.en: But if you listen to me, you will find a much better way.
translation.kr: 하지만 내 제안을 따른다면 훨씬 더 나은 방법을 찾을 수 있을 것이오.

translation.en: Choose the best man among you.
translation.kr: 당신들 중에서 가장 훌륭한 자를 고르시오.

translation.en: Let him complete the tasks that I demand.
translation.kr: 그리고 그가 내가 요구하는 과업들을 완수하게 하시오.

translation.en: If he succeeds, I will give him the golden fleece as a prize.
translation.kr: 성공한다면 그에게 황금 양모를 상으로 주겠소.

translation.en: It will be a great glory to all of you.
translation.kr: 그것은 당신들 모두에게도 큰 영광이 될 것이오.

part: Part IV: How the Argonauts Sailed to Colchis
raw: So saying, he turned his horses and drove back in silence to the town. And the Minuai sat silent with sorrow, and longed for Heracles and his strength; for there was no facing the thousands of the Colchians and the fearful chance of war.

translation.en: After speaking, the king turned his horses and drove back to the city in silence.
translation.kr: 그렇게 말한 뒤, 왕은 말머리를 돌려 아무 말 없이 도시로 돌아갔습니다.

translation.en: The Minyans sat in silent sorrow.
translation.kr: 미니아스인들은 슬픔에 잠겨 말없이 앉아 있었습니다.

translation.en: They deeply missed Heracles and his immense strength.
translation.kr: 그들은 헤라클레스와 그의 엄청난 힘을 몹시 그리워했습니다.

translation.en: They could not possibly face thousands of Colchian warriors in a terrifying war.
translation.kr: 수천 명의 콜키스 전사들과 맞서 끔찍한 전쟁을 치를 수는 없었기 때문입니다.

part: Part IV: How the Argonauts Sailed to Colchis
raw: But Chalciope, Phrixus’ widow, went weeping to the town; for she remembered her Minuan husband, and all the pleasures of her youth, while she watched the fair faces of his kinsmen, and their long locks of golden hair.  And she whispered to Medeia her sister, ‘Why should all these brave men die? why does not my father give them up the fleece, that my husband’s spirit may have rest?’

translation.en: But Phrixus's widow, Chalciope, went back to the city in tears.
translation.kr: 하지만 프리크소스의 미망인인 칼키오페는 눈물을 흘리며 도시로 돌아갔습니다.

translation.en: She remembered her Minyan husband and the joys of her youth.
translation.kr: 그녀는 미니아스인이었던 남편과 젊은 시절의 기쁨을 떠올렸습니다.

translation.en: She felt this as she watched his kinsmen with their fair faces and long golden hair.
translation.kr: 아름다운 얼굴에 긴 금발을 가진 남편의 동족들을 보았기 때문입니다.

translation.en: She whispered softly to her sister, Medea.
translation.kr: 그녀는 여동생 메데이아에게 작게 속삭였습니다.

translation.en: Why should all these brave men have to die?
translation.kr: 왜 이 용감한 남자들이 모두 죽어야만 하는 걸까?

translation.en: Why does our father not simply give them the fleece?
translation.kr: 왜 아버지는 그냥 그들에게 양모를 내주지 않으시는 걸까?

translation.en: Then my husband's spirit could finally find rest.
translation.kr: 그러면 내 남편의 영혼도 마침내 안식을 찾을 수 있을 텐데.
